_source.note: make iam-request-resources-check re-derives every operation's resources from botocore; make iam-request-resources-verify checks every action, type and format against AWS.

clientsNotRead.eventbridgev2: EventBridge V2, the AWSEventsV2 target over Smithy RPC v2 CBOR on the eventsv2 endpoint, which Floci does not serve; its operations share EventBridge's names and name their resources by other members
clientsNotRead.kinesisanalytics: Kinesis Data Analytics v1, SQL applications on the KinesisAnalytics_20150814 target, which Floci does not serve (it serves v2, kinesisanalyticsv2); its operations share v2's names and name their resources by other members
